# VibeShield — Complete LLM & Developer Reference

> Zero-dependency security scanner CLI, GitHub Action, and Web Pro workbench for AI-built web applications.

## Capabilities

1. **Client JavaScript Bundle Unpacking:** Fetches and inspects live Next.js (`/_next/static/chunks/*.js`) and Vite (`/assets/*.js`) chunks across 38 secret signatures (OpenAI, Anthropic, Stripe, AWS, GitHub, Resend, Slack, private keys).
2. **Supabase & PostgREST RLS Verification:** Detects public `SUPABASE_URL` endpoints, checks for leaked `service_role` JWTs, and verifies read-only PostgREST Row-Level Security posture.
3. **Sensitive Endpoints & Security Headers:** Checks `.env`, `.git`, `.js.map` exposure, cookie attributes (`Secure`, `HttpOnly`, `SameSite`), CORS configuration, and 7 HTTP security headers.

## Usage

```bash
npx github:zColdWater/vibeshield-cli scan https://yourapp.com --min-score 80 --fail-on-secrets
```

```yaml
- uses: zColdWater/vibeshield-cli@v1
  with:
    url: https://yourapp.com
    min-score: "80"
    fail-on-secrets: "true"
    fail-on-supabase-rls: "true"
```
